scenario: All six complete recorded Agent runs, including T5, repriced uniformly at DeepSeek Flash off-peak rates at user request. Actual token usage and original receipt model identities are preserved; this is a pricing comparison, not an invoice or a claim that every run used Flash.

sources.role: Official USD rates and current model names; retrieved 2026-10-21

off_peak_schedule.off_peak: All other times, including full weekends and Chinese public holidays

version_note: Model version identifies the pricing basis only; historical token receipts retain their original API model names.
rounding: Compute in Decimal at full precision; round displayed USD values to 6 decimal places with ROUND_HALF_UP. Sum full-precision costs before rounding the aggregate.
